name: node-stats
description: node-stats is a lightweight, self-hosted system & infrastructure monitoring dashboard (Go + React). It tracks CPU, memory, disk, network, Docker and sensor metrics with live SSE updates, stores history in SQLite or PostgreSQL, and can pull full Proxmox VE / PBS topology via built-in connectors.

notes.text: First run: open http://<ip>:8080 and complete the setup wizard (create the admin, pick SQLite or PostgreSQL).
The container monitors itself out of the box. To see the Proxmox host + every VM/LXC, add a Proxmox connector after setup (admin -> Connectors).
